audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all four museum event records: each of Elliott’s three possible book readings and Gunther’s first-donation scene. Every line, embedded quotation, fictional title and name, number, conditional branch, and literary register was reviewed in full event context with canonical valley, Museum, artifact, mineral, and character terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship conditions, response IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
